title: Elite: Bind the Debt Furnace Treasury: Boss Threshold
description: Elite: Bind the Debt Furnace Treasury: Boss Threshold is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Black-Iron Debt Descent through The Black-Iron Gate (Distortion Gate bound by contract clauses). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Lucifer, Lilith, Asmodeus, Naamah enters; this beat spotlights Asmodeus as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the pre boss step at Debt Furnace Treasury, using infernal court, bargain market, and chain causeway pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Infernal Dominion is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use black iron crowns, volcanic glass armor, contract parchment skin, chain mantles, ember fissures, horn hierarchies, bat/dragon wing shadows, clawed court gloves, blood wax seals, ash velvet, obsidian thrones, coin/debt motifs, execution architecture. This elite mission takes place in The Sacred Kingdoms of Takamagahara — the avatar ventures deep into enemy territory for a high-stakes confrontation.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Black-Iron Debt Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Debt Furnace Treasury and reveals: A redacted clause hinting that some Gates may be negotiated with, never owned. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: The Solar Dominion of Khepra — enemy territory. desert temple complexes, solar pylons, Nile-black rivers, lotus fields, sandstone ruins. Realm penalty applies.
